_about: Monolith, round 5: every kept round-4 rule on (r4_vbus padpair, r4_port1 padjoin/gatevia/gndtie and pinesc on twin PD chips, r4_bcu tap_max/ret_band/pw_nogrow/mirror_skip_supply/stub_nogrow/mirror_maxa) + r5_merge capjoin and gatevia chk, on the merged placement (best + 50_r4_port1 + 60_r4_bcu). Option values are the round-4 measured ones.

pinesc._why: board data: pinesc on both PD chips (r4_port1 v5p measured U401+U501 with gndtie: blocked 5, CC1/I2CC_SCL route; r5_merge m2 with U501 only: 13/15 failed vs m1 9/14/13). The walled predicate picks only U501 on this placement (U401's pins are walled by routed neighbours, not by planned copper) and the twins test finds 4 of 5 neighbours matching (west LDO cap not copied), below twin_frac 1.0; twins=1 is on only to record twin_share in the report.

bus_layer._why: Protected copy of the high-current bus on a layer the router never routes; net/from/layer are derived (auto). The copy box is the only tuned board value: strapfix (round 3) picked it on routed loss. Derived box (auto) on the best placement: same screen (5 of 369, 0.834 W) but routed loss 1.201 W against 1.127 W with this box (r4_general/NOTES.md).
soft fill of the return net on the outer layer away from the hot loops (gives GND back the In4 area)

pad_join._why: expected per-pad findings (board data, not tuning): the charter's allowed opens (3V3 at L201 = the J301 piece seen from the other side; J301/J302 test GND) and the PD chips' small VBUS_32 supply pin (IC supply, mA, router-finished; dc_score lists it as pads_not_joined). Same list as r4_vbus/allow.json.
